item.tib: mchod gtor a dkar lha rgyun
item.coloph: gcod gdams rin chen phreng ba'i kha tshar mchod gtor a dkar lha rgyun zhes bya ba/ mkhas pa stong rgyung mthu chen gyis mdzad nas grub thob drung mu ha ra la gdams so/ des las can sems dpa' brgyad la spel/ dbog zhe ba bsod nams tshul rgyal gyis gcod gdams nyams su len skabs bla brang ma tshang gi phya (phyag) dpe ma tshang ba rnams gsar bzhengs thog lan gcig zhus 'khrul ('phrul) kyang bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//
